newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Nutricia says baby milk powder cleared.
newsitem.headline: Nutricia says baby milk powder cleared.

text.p: Dutch food group Nutricia NV said on Tuesday UK health authorities had not been able to find any contaminants in its Milumil baby milk powder withdrawn in January over a possible link with salmonella poisoning.

"They have not been able to find anything in the product, the factory or the raw materials," a Nutricia spokesman said. "We met with the authorities on Friday...and they have said we can start discussions to reintroduce the product."
"They felt that we had taken appropriate action and, for them, the case is closed," the spokesman said.
He could not give any definite date for discussions on bringing the product back to the market.

Nutricia withdrew Milumil, made by German subsidiary Milupa and sold only in Britain and Ireland, on January 24 after Britain's Department of Health raised concerns it might be linked to cases of salmonella anatum infection in babies.
The company noted at the time no direct link had been established between the product and the infections. -- Amsterdam newsroom +31 20 504 5000, Fax +31 20 504 5040
